Title: Heart of Darkness question [LSJ or others]

Messages.Author: Luis P. Duarte
Messages.Body:
Hi!

Heart of Darkness text:
Inferior: "Put this card on the acting vampire.
Aggravated damage taken by this vampire is changed to
normal damage. (...)
Superior: "As above, and prevent 1 damage to the vampire
each combat."

Question 1: Can the vampire with this card use it after playing
a Force of Will, to change the 2 aggravated damage to
2 normal damage?

Question 2: Can a vampire have more than 1 HoD "with him"?

Thanx all!
.- Luis....@ip.pt

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Luis P. Duarte wrote:
> Heart of Darkness text:
> Inferior: "Put this card on the acting vampire.
> Aggravated damage taken by this vampire is changed to
> normal damage. (...)
> Superior: "As above, and prevent 1 damage to the vampire
> each combat."
>
> Question 1: Can the vampire with this card use it after playing
> a Force of Will, to change the 2 aggravated damage to
> 2 normal damage?

Yes (indeed, it happens automatically - he cannot choose not to).

> Question 2: Can a vampire have more than 1 HoD "with him"?

Yes.
